title: Speculative Decoding for LLM Serving: A Survey
abstract: (上传 PDF)覆盖 draft 构造、验证成本模型与 serving 集成三条线的综述草稿,解析出 42 页正文与 312 条引用。

title: ThunderKV: Fused Attention Kernels for Long-Context Serving
abstract: We introduce ThunderKV, a family of fused attention kernels that co-schedule KV-cache reads with speculative verification. On shared-prefix workloads ThunderKV reduces memory stalls by 2.1× and composes with existing tree-drafting schedulers without modification.

title: KVPress: Structured KV-Cache Compression for Serving
abstract: KVPress compresses the KV cache with attention-aware block pruning for long-context serving. Compression decisions are made per layer against a measured recall budget, and the pruned layout composes with speculative verification kernels without kernel changes.

title: Mixtral of Experts
abstract: (要点转写)8×7B 稀疏 MoE,每个 token 路由到 2 个 expert,以 13B 级激活成本逼近 70B 级质量;router 的路由行为正是本库 MoE serving 主题关注的信号来源。
